power.lavagenesis.flare.desc: Melt the rock you look at into lava. Hold to keep carving.
power.lavagenesis.lava_spit.desc: Lob a glob of lava that splashes into cooling rock, burning what it hits.
power.lavagenesis.flow_surge.desc: Dash forward as a river of fire, leaving a trail of cooling lava.
power.lavagenesis.pillow_mound.desc: Heap a mound of pillow lava on the sea floor in front of you to raise your seamount.
power.lavagenesis.eruption.desc: A lava fountain at your target: builds a cone of fresh rock and flings lava bombs.
power.lavagenesis.shield_flow.desc: A wide, flat lava flow that runs downhill and fills shallow sea to just above the waves.
power.lavagenesis.hotspot_leap.desc: Arc 40-80 blocks over open ocean and raise a seed island with a new vent. Look up to leap further.
power.lavagenesis.bomb_rain.desc: Hurl a volley of volcanic bombs over a wide area: many small patches of land, and pain for mobs.
power.lavagenesis.great_eruption.desc: An ash column split by lightning, a rain of bombs and a huge new cone of rock.
msg.lavagenesis.power.pressure: Not enough pressure for %s: needs %s, you have %s
msg.lavagenesis.power.no_target: Nothing to aim at within %s blocks
msg.lavagenesis.power.no_room: No room for new rock there
msg.lavagenesis.power.unlocked: Press %s to unleash %s (it is now selected), %s to switch powers.
msg.lavagenesis.flare.own_land: Flare won't melt the living land of your islands
msg.lavagenesis.leap.look: Look out over the ocean to leap
msg.lavagenesis.leap.no_ocean: No open ocean that way: Hotspot Leap needs deep water 40-80 blocks ahead
msg.lavagenesis.leap.unloaded: The ocean that way is too far away to reach
msg.lavagenesis.leap.too_close: Too close to one of your vents (%s blocks, islands need %s)
msg.lavagenesis.leap.vent_failed: The new island rose, but its vent could not take hold
msg.lavagenesis.leap.success: A new island rises from the sea, and the hotspot feeds its vent!
